name: r2fm-ar2l-combo-large
train_command: from ultralytics import YOLO; import json, os; model = YOLO('{model}'); results = model.train(data='{data}', epochs=100, batch=32, imgsz=640, device='0,1', workers=8, project='{output_parent}', name='train', exist_ok=True, patience=20, save=True, save_period=10, val=True); rd = results.results_dict; metrics = {{'mAP50': float(rd.get('metrics/mAP50(B)', 0)), 'mAP50_95': float(rd.get('metrics/mAP50-95(B)', 0))}}; os.makedirs('{output_parent}/results', exist_ok=True); json.dump(metrics, open('{output_parent}/results/{name}.json', 'w'), indent=2); print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2))
